_comment: Liquid Glass colours per mode (docs/STANDARD.md). edge: the 1 px line on the bar, dock, quick settings capsules and widgets only; dropdowns have none in light and milky. dropdown_edge: the same line on dropdowns in dark mode only (an inset shadow, so the rows keep their gap). card: the lift of a card on glass (calendar events, weather). chip and chip_text: a small glass-look capsule drawn in CSS where the shell cannot place real glass (overview window captions), over content. Read by scripts/glass-tokens.py.
